subject: Dual-Track Demo Night — co-host details, MDF ask, and SLAs
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@altuslabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, events@altuslabs.com
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@altuslabs.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dual-Track Demo Night — proposal and quick questions

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the interest in co-hosting a Dual-Track Demo Night at our June 24 community evening. We designed the night as two parallel 40-minute tracks: one focused on enterprise inference (Redwood-friendly) and the other on edge use cases. Our team thinks Redwood would be an ideal lead for the enterprise track.

Quick things we need to confirm from your side:
- MDF request we outlined in the attached Altus_DualTrack_RFP.xlsx (line items for booth, AV, and speaker travel). Can Redwood commit to the $12k media/ops credit, or would you prefer a staffed booth + PR co-funding split?
- Staffing: 1 senior product engineer + 1 sales rep for booth presence, 1 presenter (30 min) + optional fireside (15 min) — can you confirm names and travel policy?
- SLAs/availability: we plan live Q&A with streaming and a 24-hour on-demand replay. We need to know if Redwood can commit to a 99.5% streaming availability SLA for the session and an on-call engineer during the event.

Attached is a short RFP spreadsheet and a sample agenda. If this looks good, we can put a mutual action plan in HubSpot and route a quick SOW.

Appreciate a quick reply — we need final speakers by Monday 5/18 to promote.

Best,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Partnerships, Altus Labs
liam.oneill@altuslabs.com

Attachment: Altus_DualTrack_RFP.xlsx (spreadsheet, 36 KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@altuslabs.com>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@altuslabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dual-Track Demo Night — proposal and quick questions

On Sat, May 16, 2026 at 09:14 AM Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@altuslabs.com> wrote:
> Hi Irene —
> 
> Thanks again for the interest in co-hosting a Dual-Track Demo Night at our June 24 community evening. ...

Liam — thanks for the clear outline and the RFP. This is something we can support but need to align internally on budget and staffing. Initial replies below; Ben and Marissa are on copy to finalize ops.

MDF / budget: We can support a $10k co-fund from Redwood marketing for media/ops, plus a staffed presence. If Altus can cover AV and local venue fees (as listed), we can reallocate the remaining $2k to speaker travel. If Altus needs Redwood to fully front the $12k, we'll need an executive sign-off and proof of lead targets (HubSpot pings okay).

Staffing & travel: Tentatively I can present (enterprise inference overview + 10-min product demo) but will need a deep-dive engineer for the live demo. Ben — could you confirm an engineer who can travel on 6/24 and we can cover coach airfare + 1 hotel night? We prefer to keep travel guidelines to standard Redwood travel policy (coach unless pre-approved biz).

SLA & streaming: We cannot guarantee a third-party stream 99.5% SLA without more info on the platform. However, Redwood can provide an on-call engineer (Ben or an assigned SRE) for the duration and will host the demo from a dedicated Redwood instance to reduce risk. We'll accept a 99% target if Altus manages the CDN and recording.

Next steps proposed:
1) Ben to confirm engineer by EOD Monday 5/18.
2) Marketing (Marissa) to confirm co-fund amount and check whether funds can be applied to speaker travel.
3) Draft SOW (I can start) and share a DocuSign link for signatures.

I will start a one-page SOW draft and upload to HubSpot once we lock the budget + names.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@altuslabs.com>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@altuslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dual-Track Demo Night — proposal and quick questions

Irene / team —

Confirmed: I can send Sam Patel (senior infra engineer) to the event. He is available 6/23–6/25 for travel. Travel cost estimate: $520 round-trip + $220 hotel (1 night) + per diem — estimate $850 total. We will bill speaker travel against the $2k speaker pool if Altus agrees to the $10k co-fund split.

Streaming SLA: Sam will be on-call for the live demo and will stay connected to our private streaming instance. We will provide a runbook and pre-event checklist by 6/16. That said, we will need Altus to confirm which CDN/provider they will use for the public stream so we can coordinate failover.

Attachments: I attached a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf) with the scope: 30-minute demo, 15-minute Q&A, 1 follow-up on-demand clip. Also included is a short list of AV requirements. Please review and comment.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Field Marketing Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@altuslabs.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@altuslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dual-Track Demo Night — proposal and quick questions

Liam / team —

Thanks — this all looks doable. A couple of operational clarifications from the field marketing side:

- Promotion window: we need finalized speaker names by EOD Tuesday 5/18 to hit our 7-day promo cadence. If we miss that, we'll push paid social and the email invite to the following week which will reduce expected attendance by ~30%.
- Booth staffing: we will staff booth coverage from Redwood PDX team 4–6pm, then handoff to on-site Sam for the demo. I will schedule two SDRs for lead capture (names TBD).
- MDF routing: finance needs a mutual action plan + HubSpot invoice copy before we commit funds. I linked the HubSpot company record above. Once Liam confirms Altus AV concessions in writing (email ok), I'll approve reallocation of $2k to travel.

I'll add comments to Ben's SOW draft by tomorrow morning. After that, Irene — if you're comfortable, can you open a DocuSign envelope for the SOW once it's updated? I can shepherd approvals on the Redwood side.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
